name: mcp-server-inspector
title: MCP Server Inspector
description: Inspect health of MCP servers in ~/.ai-code/mcp and manage their connections in Cursor, Claude Code, and Claude Desktop.
author: kittapon

commands.name: inspect-mcp-servers
commands.title: Inspect MCP Servers
commands.description: Check whether MCP servers in ~/.ai-code/mcp are working and see which clients use them.

commands.name: add-mcp-server
commands.title: Add MCP Server
commands.description: Add a new MCP server definition to ~/.ai-code/mcp/servers.json.

commands.name: connect-mcp-server
commands.title: Connect MCP Server
commands.description: Add an MCP server from ~/.ai-code/mcp to Cursor, Claude Code, or Claude Desktop.

commands.name: configure-client
commands.title: Configure Client MCP Servers
commands.description: Choose exactly which ~/.ai-code/mcp servers a client uses — unchecked servers are removed.
